keywords: Render Phase, Commit Phase, DOM Updates, Performance

question.t: 關於 React 的「渲染階段 (Render Phase)」與「提交階段 (Commit Phase)」，下列敘述何者最準確地描述了效能優化的核心心智模型？
question.en: Regarding React's 'Render Phase' and 'Commit Phase', which of the following statements most accurately describes the core mental model for performance optimization?

options.t: 只要元件函式被執行 (Render)，瀏覽器就一定會更新真實的 DOM 節點。
options.en: Whenever a component function is executed (Render), the browser will inevitably update the real DOM nodes.

options.t: 效能優化的首要目標是減少 Commit Phase 的成本，因為 Render Phase 的計算成本通常可以忽略不計。
options.en: The primary goal of performance optimization is to reduce the cost of the Commit Phase, as the computational cost of the Render Phase is usually negligible.

options.t: React 元件的執行 (Render) 純粹是 JavaScript 計算；優化目標通常是減少 Render 的頻率與計算量，以避免不必要的 Diffing 與 Commit。
options.en: The execution of a React component (Render) is purely JavaScript calculation; the optimization goal is usually to reduce the frequency and load of Renders to avoid unnecessary Diffing and Commits.

options.t: Commit Phase 負責計算 Virtual DOM Tree 的差異，而 Render Phase 負責將差異應用到畫面上。
options.en: The Commit Phase is responsible for calculating differences in the Virtual DOM Tree, while the Render Phase is responsible for applying those differences to the screen.

why.t: React 的更新分為兩個階段：Render Phase 負責呼叫元件函式並進行 Diffing (JS 計算)，Commit Phase 負責操作真實 DOM。Render 不代表 DOM 一定會更新，但頻繁的 Render 仍會消耗 CPU 進行 Diffing，因此優化重點在於減少不必要的 Render Phase。
why.en: React updates happen in two phases: the Render Phase calls component functions and performs Diffing (JS calculation), while the Commit Phase manipulates the real DOM. A Render does not guarantee a DOM update, but frequent Renders still consume CPU for Diffing, so the optimization focus is on reducing unnecessary Render Phases.

question.t: 觀察上述程式碼，當使用者點擊 `Parent` 元件中的按鈕增加 `count` 時，`Child` 元件是否會重新渲染？原因為何？
question.en: Observing the code above, when the user clicks the button in the `Parent` component to increment `count`, will the `Child` component re-render? Why?

options.t: 不會。因為 `Child` 被 `React.memo` 包裹，且 `config` 的內容 (`color`, `text`) 並沒有改變。
options.en: No. Because `Child` is wrapped in `React.memo`, and the content of `config` (`color`, `text`) has not changed.

options.t: 會。因為 `React.memo` 只能對基本型別 (primitives) 進行比較，無法比較物件。
options.en: Yes. Because `React.memo` can only compare primitives and cannot compare objects.

options.t: 會。因為 `Parent` 每次渲染時都會建立一個新的 `config` 物件參考 (Reference)，導致 `React.memo` 的淺層比較 (Shallow Comparison) 失敗。
options.en: Yes. Because `Parent` creates a new `config` object reference on every render, causing `React.memo`'s Shallow Comparison to fail.

options.t: 不會。React 會自動偵測物件內容是否相同 (Deep Comparison) 來決定是否更新。
options.en: No. React automatically detects if the object content is identical (Deep Comparison) to decide whether to update.

why.t: 這是常見的「內聯物件破壞 Memoization」陷阱。雖然物件內容相同，但每次 `Parent` 執行時，`{ color: 'red', ... }` 都是一個全新的記憶體位址。`React.memo` 預設使用 `Object.is` 進行淺層比較，因此判定 props 已變更。
why.en: This is a common 'Inline Objects Breaking Memoization' pitfall. Although the object content is the same, `{ color: 'red', ... }` is a brand new memory address every time `Parent` executes. `React.memo` uses `Object.is` for shallow comparison by default, thus determining that props have changed.

keywords: Virtualization, Windowing, Large Lists, DOM Performance

question.t: 您正在開發一個社交媒體 Feed，該頁面需要實作「無限捲動 (Infinite Scroll)」，隨著使用者捲動，DOM 節點數量會線性增長至數千個，導致頁面卡頓。
question.en: You are developing a social media Feed that requires 'Infinite Scroll'. As the user scrolls, the number of DOM nodes grows linearly to thousands, causing the page to lag.

question.t: 在不改變產品需求的前提下，下列哪種優化策略最能直接解決「DOM 節點過多」造成的效能瓶頸？
question.en: Without changing product requirements, which of the following optimization strategies most directly addresses the performance bottleneck caused by 'excessive DOM nodes'?

options.t: 對列表中的每個項目元件使用 `React.memo` 並確保 props 的引用穩定性。
options.en: Use `React.memo` for each item component in the list and ensure referential stability of props.

options.t: 實作虛擬化 (Virtualization / Windowing) 技術，只渲染當前可視區域內的項目。
options.en: Implement Virtualization (Windowing) techniques to render only the items within the current visible area.

options.t: 將列表資料放入 Context 中，避免 Props Drilling。
options.en: Put the list data into Context to avoid Props Drilling.

options.t: 使用 `useTransition` hook 來降低渲染列表的優先級。
options.en: Use the `useTransition` hook to lower the priority of rendering the list.

why.t: 雖然 `React.memo` 可以減少 Re-render，但無法解決 DOM 節點過多導致的記憶體佔用與樣式重算 (Recalculate Style) 問題。虛擬化 (Virtualization) 能將 DOM 節點數量維持在常數 (O(ViewPort Size))，是解決大量列表效能問題的終極方案。
why.en: While `React.memo` reduces re-renders, it cannot solve the memory usage and style recalculation costs caused by excessive DOM nodes. Virtualization keeps the DOM node count constant (O(ViewPort Size)), making it the ultimate solution for large list performance issues.

keywords: Context API, Context Hell, Performance Pitfalls, Re-renders

question.t: 關於 React Context 的效能陷阱，當一個包含多個屬性 (如 `{ user, theme, settings }`) 的大型 Context Provider 更新了其中一個屬性 (如 `theme`) 時，下列敘述何者正確？
question.en: Regarding React Context performance pitfalls, when a large Context Provider containing multiple properties (e.g., `{ user, theme, settings }`) updates one of them (e.g., `theme`), which of the following statements is true?

options.t: 只有使用到 `theme` 的消費者元件 (Consumers) 會重新渲染。
options.en: Only Consumer components that use `theme` will re-render.

options.t: 所有使用該 Context 的消費者元件都會重新渲染，即使它們只依賴未改變的 `user` 屬性。
options.en: All Consumer components using that Context will re-render, even if they only depend on the unchanged `user` property.

options.t: React 會自動進行 Selector 檢查，只有當元件解構出來的值改變時才會觸發更新。
options.en: React automatically performs Selector checks and only triggers updates when the destructured values change.

options.t: 只要 Context Value 的物件參考 (Reference) 保持不變，即使內容改變也不會觸發任何更新。
options.en: As long as the Context Value object reference remains unchanged, no updates will be triggered even if the content changes.

why.t: 這是 Context 的原生行為：一旦 Provider 的 `value` 發生變化 (Reference 改變)，所有訂閱該 Context 的元件都會強制重新渲染。React Context 本身不具備像 Redux 或 Zustand 的 Selector 機制來細粒度控制更新。
why.en: This is the native behavior of Context: once the Provider's `value` changes (Reference changes), all components subscribed to that Context are forced to re-render. React Context itself does not have a Selector mechanism like Redux or Zustand for fine-grained update control.

question.t: 在面試中，面試官請你解釋 `useMemo` 與 `useCallback` 的主要區別。下列哪一個回答最能展現資深工程師的理解？
question.en: In an interview, the interviewer asks you to explain the main difference between `useMemo` and `useCallback`. Which of the following answers best demonstrates a Senior Engineer's understanding?

options.t: `useMemo` 用於快取元件，`useCallback` 用於快取 DOM 事件。
options.en: `useMemo` is used to cache components, while `useCallback` is used to cache DOM events.

options.t: `useMemo` 執行函式並回傳其「計算結果」，主要用於避免昂貴計算；`useCallback` 回傳「函式本身」，主要用於保持引用穩定性以配合 `React.memo` 或依賴陣列。
options.en: `useMemo` executes the function and returns its 'calculated result', mainly to avoid expensive calculations; `useCallback` returns the 'function itself', mainly to maintain referential stability for `React.memo` or dependency arrays.

options.t: `useMemo` 的依賴陣列是選填的，而 `useCallback` 的依賴陣列是必填的。
options.en: The dependency array for `useMemo` is optional, whereas for `useCallback` it is mandatory.

options.t: 兩者完全相同，只是語法糖不同，`useCallback(fn, deps)` 等同於 `useMemo(() => fn(), deps)`。
options.en: They are exactly the same, just different syntactic sugar; `useCallback(fn, deps)` is equivalent to `useMemo(() => fn(), deps)`.

why.t: 這是最精確的定義。`useMemo` 快取的是值 (Value)，解決計算成本問題；`useCallback` 快取的是函式參考 (Function Reference)，解決因函式重建導致子元件無效渲染的問題。選項 (4) 錯誤在於 `useCallback(fn, deps)` 等同於 `useMemo(() => fn, deps)`，而不是 `() => fn()`。
why.en: This is the most precise definition. `useMemo` caches a Value, solving computation cost issues; `useCallback` caches a Function Reference, solving unnecessary re-renders in child components caused by function recreation. Option (4) is incorrect because `useCallback(fn, deps)` is equivalent to `useMemo(() => fn, deps)`, not `() => fn()`.

question.t: 在上述程式碼中，點擊 `handleClick` 後，React 是否會觸發重新渲染？這與 React 的哪項機制有關？
question.en: In the code above, will React trigger a re-render after clicking `handleClick`? Which React mechanism is this related to?

options.t: 會渲染。因為 `setState` 被呼叫了。
options.en: It will render. Because `setState` was called.

options.t: 不會渲染。因為 React 使用 `Object.is` 比較新舊 State，發現 Reference 相同，因此觸發 Bailout 機制跳過更新。
options.en: It will not render. Because React uses `Object.is` to compare the new and old State, finds the Reference identical, and triggers the Bailout mechanism to skip the update.

options.t: 會渲染。因為 `state.count` 的值確實改變了。
options.en: It will render. Because the value of `state.count` did indeed change.

options.t: 不會渲染。因為 React 不支援物件型別的 State。
options.en: It will not render. Because React does not support object-type State.

why.t: React 在更新 State 時會進行淺層比較 (Shallow Comparison)。這裡直接修改了 `state` 物件的內容 (Mutation) 並將同一個物件傳回 `setState`。React 判定 `Object.is(oldState, newState)` 為 true，因此認為狀態未變，啟動 Bailout 機制而不進行 Render。
why.en: React performs a shallow comparison when updating State. Here, the content of the `state` object is mutated directly, and the same object is passed back to `setState`. React determines `Object.is(oldState, newState)` is true, considers the state unchanged, and initiates the Bailout mechanism, skipping the Render.
